definitions.explanation: Baby talk word for food or eating. One of the first words many Japanese children learn.

examples.japanese: まんま⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
まんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「まんま」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。

notes:
WORD FORMATION: From {飯|まま} (cooked rice, meal) with vowel change for baby talk.

USAGE: One of the earliest words Japanese babies learn to say, along with ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧ (mama) and ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧ (papa).

NOTE: Not to be confused with the adverb まんま (as is, unchanged), which has different origins.

RELATED BABY TALK WORDS:
- ⟦おてて→おてて：09104_otete⟧ (hands)
- ⟦おめめ→おめめ：09105_omeme⟧ (eyes)
- ⟦あんよ→あんよ：09106_anyo⟧ (feet/walking)
- ねん⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ (sleep)

RELATED WORDS:
- ごはん (rice, meal - neutral)
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ (meal - formal)
